218:     # completed owned operation. This captures identities, never OS metadata.

220:     _assert(type(port) is GeneratedLifecyclePort and port.lifecycle is manager

225:             and not owner._revoked and not owner._closing and not owner._closed_verified
226:             and manager._tokens.get(port.key) is token and token.worker is owner._worker

241:             and pair.closed is False and pair.unconfirmed is False
242:             and worker.unconfirmed is False and protection.unconfirmed is False
243:             and worker.assigned is True and worker.resumed is True
244:             and protection.released is False and protection.worker_reserved is True
245:             and type(worker.creation_time) is int and worker.creation_time > 0

247:             and getattr(port.retire_interrupted_worker, '__self__', None) is port

275:     # Pure current-identity check. The native primitive owner remains private
276:     # and serial; no manager lock is held across a native wait or close.
277:     _assert(type(native) is _InterruptedNativeBinding, 'exact_interrupted_native_binding')
278:     m, port, p, pair, worker, protection = (native.manager, native.port,
279:         native.primitives, native.pair, native.worker, native.protection)
280:     _assert(type(port) is GeneratedLifecyclePort and m._delegate is port
281:             and port.lifecycle is m and port.primitives is p and port.pipes is native.pipes
282:             and p.api is native.api and p.api.ffi is native.ffi
283:             and type(native.pipes) is PrivatePipeController and native.pipes.primitives is p
284:             and port.pair is pair and type(pair) is PipePair and pair.lock is native.pair_lock
285:             and any(item is pair for item in native.pipes.pairs)
286:             and port.worker is worker and type(worker) is WorkerRecord
287:             and any(item is worker for item in p.workers)
288:             and port.read_set is protection and type(protection) is ReadSet
289:             and any(item is protection for item in p.read_sets)
290:             and pair.worker is worker and pair.read_set is protection and worker.read_set is protection
291:             and port.permit is native.permit and port.channel is native.channel
292:             and m._kernel._starts.get(native.permit) is worker
293:             and pair.server is native.server and pair.client is native.client
294:             and worker.process is native.process and worker.thread is native.thread and worker.job is native.job
295:             and len(protection.members) == len(native.members)
296:             and all(a is b for a, b in zip(protection.members, native.members))
297:             and len(worker.inherited_copies) == len(native.inherited)
298:             and all(a is b for a, b in zip(worker.inherited_copies, native.inherited))
299:             and worker.creation_time == native.creation_time and worker.creation_info is native.creation_info
300:             and worker.creation_info.pid == native.pid and worker.assigned is True
301:             and worker.resumed is True and protection.worker_reserved is True
302:             and pair.role == 'controller' and pair.active is False and not pair.operations
303:             and getattr(port.retire_interrupted_worker, '__self__', None) is port
304:             and getattr(port.retire_interrupted_worker, '__func__', None) is native.retire.__func__
305:             and getattr(native.token.service._reconcile_live, '__self__', None) is port
306:             and getattr(native.token.service._reconcile_live, '__func__', None) is native.reconcile.__func__,
307:             'interrupted_native_binding_changed')

315:             'aggregate_quarantine_history_must_remain')

337: class _InterruptedOperationProbe:
338:     """One fixed Python interruption during operation; never an OS signal."""
339:     def __init__(self, port, setup):
340:         _assert(type(port) is GeneratedLifecyclePort
341:                 and type(setup) is journal_setup_module.GeneratedJournalSetup
342:                 and setup.port is port and setup.gates is port.reservations.gates
343:                 and port.key is None and port.worker is None,
344:                 "fixed_interrupted_probe_before_lease")
345:         self.port, self.setup = port, setup
346:         self.error = KeyboardInterrupt("fixed_after_second_segment_exchange")
347:         self.armed = self.fired = self.observed = self.close_observed = False
348:         self.owner = self.record = self.token = self.worker = self.gate_attempt = None
349:         self.manager_attempt = self.service_attempt = None
350:         self.raw = self.head = self.handle = self.revision = self.close_head = None
351:         self.quarantine_raw = self.quarantine_head = None
352:         self.quarantine_revision = self.native = None

354:     def interrupt_after_exchange(self, worker):
355:         port, setup = self.port, self.setup
356:         _assert(self.armed and not self.fired and not self.observed
357:                 and port._interrupted_probe is self and setup._interrupted_probe is self
358:                 and port._next_index == 2 and port.worker is worker,
359:                 "exact_interrupted_boundary_before_fixed_interrupt")
360:         token = port.lifecycle._token(port.key)
361:         record = port.lifecycle._records.get(port.key)
362:         attempt = setup.gates.attempts.get(token.physical)
363:         _assert(record is not None and record.owner is not None
364:                 and record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RUNNING
365:                 and record.owner._worker is worker and token.worker is worker
366:                 and token.phase == "WORKER_BOUND" and not token.revoked
367:                 and token.pending is None and setup.flush_successes == 3
368:                 and attempt is not None and attempt.token is token.gate
369:                 and attempt.journal is token.journal and attempt.failure is None
370:                 and attempt.handle is setup.created_handle and not attempt.handle.closed
371:                 and not attempt.handle.unconfirmed and token.journal.confirmed_bytes == token.raw
372:                 and token.journal.confirmed_revision == token.journal._stream.write_revision
373:                 and not token.journal._poisoned and not token.journal._stream.poisoned,
374:                 "exact_running_boundary_before_interruption")
375:         rows, head = decode_journal(token.raw)
376:         _assert([r["phase"] for r in rows] == ["INITIALIZED", "RESERVED", "WORKER_BOUND"],
377:                 "fixed_interrupt_has_three_confirmed_frames")
378:         self.owner, self.record, self.token, self.worker = record.owner, record, token, worker
379:         self.gate_attempt, self.handle = attempt, attempt.handle
380:         self.raw, self.head, self.revision = token.raw, head, token.revision
381:         self.native = port.lifecycle._remember_interrupted_boundary(self)
382:         self.fired = True
383:         raise self.error
384: 
385:     def observe_interruption(self, error):
386:         port, token, record, setup = self.port, self.token, self.record, self.setup
387:         _assert(error is self.error and self.fired and not self.observed
388:                 and port.lifecycle._records.get(port.key) is record and record.owner is self.owner
389:                 and record.phase is Phase.QUARANTINED and record.protection is port.read_set
390:                 and self.owner._revoked is True and not self.owner._closed_verified and self.owner._active == 0
391:                 and token is port.lifecycle._token(port.key) and token.phase == "QUARANTINED"
392:                 and token.revoked is True and token.pending is None
393:                 and setup.flush_successes == 4 and not self.handle.closed and not self.handle.unconfirmed
394:                 and setup.gates._held.get(token.physical) is token.gate
395:                 and setup.gates.attempts.get(token.physical) is self.gate_attempt
396:                 and self.gate_attempt.failure is None,
397:                 "same_interrupted_owner_quarantined_with_four_frames")
398:         rows, head = decode_journal(token.raw)
399:         _assert(token.raw.startswith(self.raw) and rows[-1]["previous"] == self.head
400:                 and [r["phase"] for r in rows] == ["INITIALIZED", "RESERVED", "WORKER_BOUND", "QUARANTINED"],
401:                 "quarantined_journal_has_four_frames")
402:         _require_interrupted_bindings(self.native)
403:         _assert(port.lifecycle._interrupted_boundaries.get(port.key) is self.native
404:                 and type(token.revision) is int and token.revision > self.revision,
405:                 "exact_post_quarantine_boundary_revision")
406:         self.observed = True
407:         self.quarantine_raw, self.quarantine_head = token.raw, head
408:         self.quarantine_revision = token.revision

410:     def bind_service_attempt(self, worker, physical, generation, head, attempt):
411:         port, token = self.port, self.token
412:         _assert(port._interrupted_retired(worker), "interrupted_retired_worker_required_for_service_bind")
413:         manager_attempt = port.lifecycle._interrupted_retirements.get(port.key)
414:         _assert(self.observed and self.service_attempt is None and not self.close_observed
415:                 and type(manager_attempt) is _InterruptedRetirement
416:                 and manager_attempt.manager is port.lifecycle and manager_attempt.owner is self.owner
417:                 and manager_attempt.record is self.record and manager_attempt.token is token
418:                 and manager_attempt.worker is worker and worker is self.worker
419:                 and manager_attempt.raw == self.quarantine_raw and manager_attempt.head == self.quarantine_head
420:                 and manager_attempt.revision == self.quarantine_revision
421:                 and physical == token.physical and generation == token.generation and head == self.quarantine_head
422:                 and token.raw == self.quarantine_raw and token.revision == self.quarantine_revision
423:                 and token.journal.confirmed_bytes == self.quarantine_raw
424:                 and token.journal.confirmed_revision == token.journal._stream.write_revision
425:                 and not token.journal._poisoned and not token.journal._stream.poisoned
426:                 and token.phase == "CLEAR_PENDING" and token.revoked is True
427:                 and type(attempt) is object and token.pending is attempt,
428:                 "fixed_manager_and_service_interrupted_attempt")
429:         self.manager_attempt, self.service_attempt = manager_attempt, attempt

432:         port, setup = self.port, self.setup
433:         _assert(port._interrupted_retired(self.worker) and port.pair.worker is self.worker
434:                 and not port.pair.operations and port.pair.closed
435:                 and self.worker.read_set is port.read_set
436:                 and all(h.closed and not h.unconfirmed for h in (self.worker.process, self.worker.thread, self.worker.job))
437:                 and all(h.closed and not h.unconfirmed for h in port.read_set.members),
438:                 "interrupted_recovery_has_no_uncertain_retained_native_owners")
439:         rows, head = decode_journal(token.raw)
440:         _assert(self.observed and not self.close_observed and self.service_attempt is not None
441:                 and token is self.token and port.lifecycle._interrupted_retirements.get(port.key) is self.manager_attempt
442:                 and self.manager_attempt.owner is self.owner and self.manager_attempt.token is token
443:                 and port.lifecycle._records.get(port.key) is self.record
444:                 and self.record.owner is self.owner and self.record.phase is Phase.QUARANTINED
445:                 and self.record.protection is None
446:                 and self.owner._revoked is True and self.owner._closed_verified is True
447:                 and port._interrupted_retired(self.worker)
448:                 and token.revoked is True and token.phase == "CLEAR_PENDING" and token.pending is None
449:                 and token.revision == self.quarantine_revision and token.worker is self.worker
450:                 and token.raw.startswith(self.quarantine_raw) and rows[-1]["previous"] == self.quarantine_head
451:                 and [r["phase"] for r in rows] == ["INITIALIZED", "RESERVED", "WORKER_BOUND", "QUARANTINED", "CLEARED"]
452:                 and setup.gates._held.get(token.physical) is token.gate
453:                 and setup.gates.attempts.get(token.physical) is self.gate_attempt
454:                 and self.gate_attempt.journal is token.journal and self.gate_attempt.handle is self.handle
455:                 and self.gate_attempt.failure is None and self.handle is setup.created_handle
